scope_note: Selected macroeconomic series with all available ALFRED realtime intervals since 2016, fixed realtime cutoff; observation periods and vintage intervals are distinct. Initial scope is the configured series list, not the full FRED catalog.
Daily temperature, corrected precipitation and solar radiation for eight named regional reference locations. Current reanalysis retrieval, not original forecast vintages or plant-specific exposure.
All-company monthly filing index including corrections, date and receipt identifiers since 2016; original report downloads and financial-statement extraction are separate.
DOI metadata for dataset, software and dissertation resource-type filters, partitioned by DOI creation month; publication dates, usage and revisions remain distinct; no linked content downloaded.

bioRxiv and medRxiv preprint metadata by posting month and version; initial dates before service operation can have empty queries, not proof of historical public availability. No article bodies are downloaded.
Public research artifact metadata by publication month, preserving source precision and identifiers. Ten-thousand-result scopes remain blocked for splitting; files and usage vintages are separate.

Public model and dataset repository metadata sorted by creation, with dated and undated source fields retained. Current metadata only; no gated content, model weights or private repositories are downloaded.

Applicant-name and existing-alias candidate discovery for the enabled company universe, including pre-2016 patents; current INPADOC legal histories retain gazette dates since 2016 and undated events. Gazette, effective, created and exchanged dates remain distinct. Applicant links are unreviewed; aliases/subsidiaries and provider omissions can leave gaps. This is not original historical vintages or a calendar-completeness certification. Daily discovery overlaps seven days; known patents rotate through bounded refresh shards.
Keyed annual imports and exports for the existing five reporters and four battery/mineral HS6 commodities; world partner totals. Initial scope, not all trade flows.
All available geography rows for monthly electricity generation and demand, since 2016; current released data, Ember CC-BY-4.0. Missing months are not inferred as zeros.

All currently catalogued indicators, all reporting economies, provider default partner/product scopes, by year since 2016; current vintages and explicit pagination. Not all bilateral/product combinations.

Notifications submitted since 2016 and restriction records entering into force since 2016. Current records, not historical database snapshots or a complete inventory of older restrictions still in force.
English SPS/TBT notification metadata, all notifying members, distribution-date partitions since 2016; includes addenda and revisions, no attached document downloads.

ERA5 and ERA5-Land hourly 2m temperature and precipitation, eight named regional reference cells since 2016. Raw NetCDF archives with checksums; structured weather extraction pending. Current reanalysis, not original forecast vintages. Dataset licence acceptance required.

Monthly US imports and exports for TOTAL and four battery/mineral HS6 commodities across all partner codes since 2016; current releases, not original vintages. Country totals and commodity totals remain distinct.

Current PSD forecasts/estimates for corn, wheat, rice, soybeans and cotton, all countries, market years since 2016. Market year differs from release date; historical forecast vintages not supplied by this route.
